end.summary:
- Discussed separating wet waste into the green bin.
- Identified food peels as wet waste.
- Practised keeping the classroom clean by using bins and cleaning personal spaces.
- Reviewed air and oxygen; Anika did not complete the teach-back.
- Anika asked about break time and requested a game.
end.parentNote: Asha practised wet-waste sorting, using the green bin, and ways to keep the classroom clean. Anika connected food peels with wet waste and suggested putting rubbish in the bin and keeping their place clean. Air and oxygen needed another review, and the teach-back was not completed before the lesson ended. At home, ask Anika to name one wet-waste item and one way to keep a room clean.
